title: C# Booleans & Expressions
description: Booleans represent values that are either 'true' or 'false'. They are the foundation of logic and decision-making in programming. You can use boolean expressions with operators like '>', '<', and '==' to evaluate conditions.

challenges.title: Boolean Comparison
challenges.exercise: Compare 10 with 5 using '=='. Print the result (should be False).
